about: THE BOARD HALF (FB-07, full width), graded by the board reading of gates 177 and 178 (gates/drive/layout.js, TC-R248e) on a trial bundle, on four states: Review at move 10, Analysis from a solved drill card, a lesson demo and a puzzle with its hint, each at eight phones (375x761, 390x844, 414x896, 430x932 with his insets; 320x568, 360x640, 375x667 and 375x730 - the room his phone leaves in the Home Screen app - without) and four text sizes. The real code passes: in Review and drill Analysis the board is the width in every cell at 50, 75 and 100 percent, and where the height caps it (125 percent on the three smallest phones) it is centred and as wide as the fixture lists. Three ways it could come undone are each caught. NOT COVERED: Play against the computer on the three short phones, which still keeps the bar beside the board (his a35 pick; pinned, a question for him); the non-Review boards at 125 percent (pinned); the explanation's tap-for-the-whole-text and the engine line taking its place on a short phone (gate 22 and gate 26 read those screens; no break here is aimed at them); his phone itself.
